$comment: GENERATED from the operations repo's .github/labels.json (`universal` for names and meanings, `order` for order, `cost.laneMinutes` for lane cost); do not hand-edit. The vocabulary is decided there and only there (#1120). Change it there, then regenerate this copy: `node <the operations repo's checkout>/scripts/plan-vocabulary/export.js > .github/plan-vocabulary.json`. Every list is in order: lanes most-costly-to-PM first (the tiebreak when an item carries two lane labels), priorities highest first, pm tiers claiming-PM first. `engagement` is the Card Shark Engagement option a lane mirrors. `costMinutes` is what a lane's next move costs PM, in minutes of PM's own time; lane:do's is a floor, not an estimate (#1127). The fleet conformance drift scan reports any divergence between this file and labels.json.

lanes.label: lane:do
lanes.meaning: Your next move is your hands, with no agent involved. Vendor portals, hardware, life admin.

lanes.label: lane:session
lanes.meaning: Your next move is working alongside an agent. Spends both, at the same time.

lanes.label: lane:decide
lanes.meaning: Your next move is a judgment that releases an agent or a person. Not the work itself.

lanes.label: lane:kick-off
lanes.meaning: Your next move starts an agent and steps back. Spends agent tokens, ~a minute of you.

pm.label: pm:action
pm.meaning: PM must do something concrete (follow up, create artifact, review, kick off build).

pm.label: pm:awareness
pm.meaning: PM should know about it; agent does the work. Default board threshold.
